shared_elements: human head with defined facial features
justification: Both depict the human form, but A is a single three-dimensional bust-like figure with a large head and roughly modelled torso, while B is a flat incised scene of two figures in profile — one seated before an offering table with a standing figure opposite — plus rows of sign-like script and small emblems in the arched top. Beyond the generic presence of humans there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme, and the modes of depiction (volumetric mass versus linear profile relief with registers) are quite different.
